createDialog.title: Add a character

preparationHero.title: Character preparation
preparationHero.description: Maintain characters as a continuously running narrative asset: fill the cast first, then switch to view profile, visible profile, resources, timeline and relations.
preparationHero.builtCharactersNone: Create a protagonist or import a base character first.
preparationHero.coreCharactersHasSome: Keep adding rivals, allies and pressure sources.
preparationHero.coreCharactersNone: At least clarify the protagonist and the main rival.

recommend.noCharacters: Build a protagonist or import a base character first so later world, volume planning and chapter generation have a clear acting subject.
recommend.noCore: Clearly mark the protagonist, main rival or key ally so later chapters don't lack a stable pressure source.

recommend.noSelection: Pick a character on the left, enter switch-maintenance mode, and move between profile, visible profile, resources and timeline.
recommend.default: Check the current goal, last appearance and key resources first, then decide whether to let AI evolve the state.

modeOptions.auto: AI decides which type of addition is more needed
modeOptions.linked: Derive a relationship character from an existing one

supplementalDialog.referenceHint: Optional; if not selected, AI decides who to build around.
